# A plugin reaches the host only through sngl:x/gen, and unasked it may
# compute and read inside the import root -- the directory the program's
# package is read from -- and nothing else. Running a command, reading the
# environment and reading outside the root are each refused, at the call,
# naming the flag that would allow it and the `sngl trust` line that would
# record it. With no terminal there is no prompt: the refusal is the answer.
env SNGL_GENCACHE=off

# Reading inside the root needs no grant: the plugin's data is the project's.
sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out-inside read/inside.sngl
grep 'from inside the root' out-inside/index.html

! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out exec/app.sngl
stderr '^pc/pc.sngl:6:13: \./pc may not run sh -c ''echo hi'': running it needs --allow-command="\./pc=sh" \(or `sngl trust --allow-command="\./pc=sh"` to record it\)$'
! exists out/index.html

! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out env/app.sngl
stderr '^pc/pc.sngl:5:13: \./pc may not read \$HOME: reading it needs --allow-env="\./pc=HOME" \(or `sngl trust --allow-env="\./pc=HOME"` to record it\)$'

# The root is the program's directory, not the working directory: run from
# the parent, the plugin still may not read the parent's files.
! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out read/outside.sngl
stderr '^pc/pc.sngl:8:20: \./pc may not read '$WORK'/secret.txt, outside the import root '$WORK'/read: reading it needs --allow-file="\./pc='$WORK'/secret.txt" \(or `sngl trust --allow-file="\./pc='$WORK'/secret.txt"` to record it\)$'

# A listing outside the root is a directory grant.
! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out read/listing.sngl
stderr '^pc/pc.sngl:16:12: \./pc may not list '$WORK', outside the import root '$WORK'/read: listing it needs --allow-dir="\./pc='$WORK'" \(or `sngl trust --allow-dir="\./pc='$WORK'"` to record it\)$'

# A symlink inside the root that points out of it is outside the root.
symlink read/escape.txt -> ../secret.txt
! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out read/escape.sngl
stderr 'may not read '$WORK'/secret.txt, outside the import root'

-- secret.txt --
the parent's secret
-- exec/app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import pc "./pc"

const v = pc.greet()

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value=v)
}
-- exec/pc/pc.sngl --
import gen "sngl:x/gen"

// What `echo` prints.
const func greet() string {
    var out = ""
    var p = gen.exec(cmd=["sh", "-c", "echo hi"])
    for var line = p.stdout {
        out = out + line
    }
    return out
}
-- env/app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import pc "./pc"

const v = pc.home()

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value=v)
}
-- env/pc/pc.sngl --
import gen "sngl:x/gen"

// Where the user lives.
const func home() string {
    var h = gen.env("HOME")
    if h != null {
        return h
    }
    return ""
}
-- read/inside.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import pc "./pc"

const v = pc.first("data.txt")

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value=v)
}
-- read/outside.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import pc "./pc"

const v = pc.first("../secret.txt")

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value=v)
}
-- read/listing.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import pc "./pc"

const v = pc.names("..")

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value=v)
}
-- read/escape.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import pc "./pc"

const v = pc.first("escape.txt")

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value=v)
}
-- read/data.txt --
from inside the root
-- read/pc/pc.sngl --
import gen "sngl:x/gen"

// The first line of path.
const func first(path string) string {
    // A plugin that stops early still records the whole file: the rest is
    // read and hashed without being handed out.

    for var line = gen.lines(path) {
        return line
    }
    return ""
}

// The names in dir, joined.
const func names(dir string) string {
    return gen.files(dir, "*").join(",")
}
